src: de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Dollar — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Dollar is the form after numerals
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Analyst — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Analysts is an English-inflected variant
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Sand — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): a mass noun in general use; Sande is technical (kinds of sand)
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Nomen — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Nomen is the school form
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Pasta — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Pasten is the plural of the other sense (paste)
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Mineral — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Mineralien is the everyday form
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Newsletter — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): the German zero plural is standard
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Bonus — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): a plural identical to the singular is marginal
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Heck — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Hecke is rare and reads as die Hecke (hedge)
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Avatar — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Avatare is the Duden form
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Tablett — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Tablette is rare and reads as die Tablette (pill)
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Eigenkapital — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): an accounting mass noun; Eigenkapitalien is technical
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Schema — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Schemen is rare and is also the plural of Schemen (phantom)
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Kiesbett — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): the page lists Kiesbetten first; Kiesbette is rare
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Kölsch — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): the beer is counted (zwei Kölsch); only the dialect sense has no plural
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Aktienkapital — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): an accounting mass noun; the plurals are technical
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Kommando — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Kommanden/Kommanda are Austrian or rare
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Staub — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): a mass noun in general use; Stäube is technical
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Nazi — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): a zero plural is marginal
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Schluck — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Schlücke is rare; Schluck is the form after numerals
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Muslim — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Muslims is an English-inflected variant
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Bogen — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Bögen is listed as southern/Austrian/Swiss but is widespread; both are accepted
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Orden — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Örden is not standard
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Lager — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Läger is the Austrian commercial plural
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Fund — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Funds belongs to the finance homograph
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Abbau — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): in the card's senses (reduction, extraction) the noun is uncounted; Abbaue/Abbauten are sites and structures
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Sturz — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Sturze is the building-trade sense (lintel)
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Ton — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): the card leads with sound/tone; Tone is the clay homograph
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Akt — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Akten belongs to die Akte (file)
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Star — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): the card is the celebrity; Stare is the bird
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Block — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): both standard across the card's senses (blocks, notepads, housing blocks)
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Bug — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): the card is the software error; Büge is the ship's bow
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Atlas — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): both given for the map-book sense
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Vorwort — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Vorwörter is the grammar homograph (prepositions)
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Sau — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Sauen is the hunting term for wild boar
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Stichwort — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Stichworte for cues and notes, Stichwörter for dictionary headwords; the card carries both senses
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Dorn — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Dorne is the technical sense (mandrel)
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Schnur — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Schnuren is the other homograph
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Sack — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Sacks is the unit after numerals
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Hammer — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): the zero plural is the other homograph
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Keks — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): das Keks with plural Keks is Austrian
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Admiral — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Admiräle is less common; the butterfly homograph shares the page
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Abdruck — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Abdrucke are printed reproductions, not impressions
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Interieur — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): the only standard plural
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Tram — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Trame/Träme belong to other genders or regions
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Silvester — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): zero plural, as in die letzten zwei Silvester
de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Radar — ruling 2026-09-25 (panel): Duden: der Radar, Plural die Radare
